name: Thandiwe Nkosi
bio:
Thandiwe's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in Soweto, she initially pursued a career in general engineering. However, a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited a passion she never knew she possessed. The precision and demand for excellence in motorsport resonated deeply with her meticulous nature.

Thandiwe's approach to her role as a machinist is rooted in a relentless pursuit of perfection. She believes that every component, no matter how small, plays a crucial role in the overall performance of the car. Her ability to quickly identify potential weaknesses and propose innovative solutions has earned her the respect of her colleagues. She's known for pushing boundaries and isn't afraid to challenge conventional thinking, which is why she fits in well at Ferrari.

What sets Thandiwe apart is her unwavering commitment to continuous improvement. She's constantly seeking out new techniques and technologies to enhance her skills. Her dedication and visionary mindset make her a valuable asset to the Scuderia Ferrari team, always looking for that extra tenth of a second.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled afro with subtle grey highlights.
physical.description: Thandiwe has a warm, expressive face framed by her short afro and radiating confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas, even in the middle of a race.
Insists on listening to classical music while working on intricate engine components.
Has a habit of adjusting her safety glasses even when they are perfectly in place.
